About the 2026 Ronix One Wakeboard

The Ronix One wakeboard is a top-tier performance board designed for riders who demand precision and pop. The One features a featherlight biax fiberglass construction combined with a progressive 3-stage rocker that delivers explosive pop off the wake.

Paired with the Ronix Anthem Boots — a high-performance open-toe boot with a heat-moldable liner for a custom fit — this combo gives you everything you need to charge the wake at the highest level.

  • check_circle Biax fiberglass layup for lightweight feel
  • check_circle 3-stage progressive rocker for explosive pop
  • check_circle Molded-in channels for edge-to-edge control
  • check_circle Anthem open-toe boots with heat-moldable liner
  • check_circle Dual base fins for consistent tracking
